MCP (Model Context Protocol) es el están: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the open standard AI assistants use to work with other programs' tools. IAQ Gest offers more than 80 tools over MCP, so every board member can connect their own assistant to their account and run the association by chatting.
Cada herramienta tiene uno de tres nivel: Each tool has one of three levels —read, write or proposal— and the assistant can only do what its owner's role allows.
Conecta su asistente de IA (Claude, Chat: Each person connects their AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor, custom agents) to their own account.
Cada persona tiene su clave (revocable y: Everyone has their own key (revocable, with an expiry date) and the assistant acts with that person's role permissions: the treasurer only sees finances.
Cobrar una remesa, borrar o publicar que: Collecting a direct debit batch, deleting or publishing become proposals that the person approves with one click.
DNI/NIE/NIF, IBAN y similares se filtran: ID numbers (DNI/NIE/NIF), IBANs and the like are filtered out automatically before they reach the model.

¿Necesito saber de IA o de informática?: Do I need to know about AI or computers?
No. Se instala como cualquier otro progr: No. It installs like any other program and a wizard guides you at the start. Connecting your AI assistant is optional, and the program explains how to do it step by step.
¿Puedo usarlo sin asistente de IA?: Can I use it without an AI assistant?
Sí. IAQ Gest es un programa completo con: Yes. IAQ Gest is a complete program with its own window; the AI assistant is one more way to use it, not a requirement.
¿El asistente puede ver los DNI o las cu: Can the assistant see ID numbers or bank accounts?
No, los datos sensibles como DNI/NIE/NIF: No. Sensitive data such as ID numbers (DNI/NIE/NIF) and bank accounts is filtered out automatically to protect privacy.
En catalán, castellano e inglés: el prog: Catalan, Spanish and English: the program, the installer, the setup wizard and the help manual. Each person picks their language and the program remembers it.

¿Puedo usarlo desde casa?: Can I use it from home?
Sí, puedes usar IAQ Gest desde casa grac: Yes, you can use IAQ Gest from home thanks to Tailscale: each board member connects to the association's computer over a private network, without exposing it to the internet. The program's help explains it step by step.
